jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Business Development Representative

Corgi is vertically integrating the entire insurance industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so.

Building something great requires working hard. We are in the office 6-7 days a week. We are meritocratic with very high standards. If you don't meet them, you'll get cut. But if you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow.

We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.

What We're Looking For

We’re hiring hard workers and fast learners. We are in-person only and full-time. The work is challenging, but we make it worthwhile. You are required to be in-office five days per week.

What You’ll Do

  • Make outbound calls to startup founders and operators.

  • Set qualified meetings and join demos with AEs.

  • Own CRM hygiene and next steps until deals are closed.

  • Rewrite, test, and refine scripts in real time—keep what converts, kill what doesn’t.

  • Learn the startup insurance landscape quickly and speak confidently with founders.

  • Work closely with sales leadership to iterate on ICP, messaging, and outreach.

What We’re Looking For

  • Hard workers and fast learners.

  • Comfortable with rejection, repetition, and pressure.

  • Confident speaking with founders and executives.

  • Self-motivated and accountable—you don’t need hand-holding.

  • Excited by building something new rather than being managed at a big company.

No prior insurance experience required—we’ll teach you the industry.

Why You Should Join

  • Ground Floor Opportunity: You’ll be helping to shape and grow a revolutionary company with the resources to back it.

  • Impact & Speed: Work in a fast-paced environment where your contributions will have immediate, tangible effects on the company’s success.

  • Growth Potential: We are launching our Lehi office from scratch. We move fast and our people do too. We prefer to promote rather than hire, and will likely have many new roles coming in the near future.

Compensation

  • Base: $60k-$70k

  • OTE: $90k OTE

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Corgi
Corgi is a full-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products for startups. We’re not a broker, so we underwrite and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Cutting out intermediaries lets us tailor coverage to how companies actually operate and price risk more efficiently.


About the role
We've raised over $108M to build insurance from the ground up. Now we're building the team that builds the team.

This is our first dedicated People hire. You'll own everything from how we find talent to how we retain it. Think recruiting, people ops, culture, comp, and everything in between. This isn't a "post jobs and review inbound" seat. We need someone who moves fast, builds from scratch, and has a hunter mentality.

What you'll do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across all functions: sourcing, closing, and everything in between

  • Stand up repeatable hiring playbooks by role and team

  • Build and run core people ops: HRIS, payroll, onboarding, compliance

  • Design comp frameworks, leveling, and performance processes as we scale

  • Shape culture intentionally… not with perks, but with systems and standards

  • Partner directly with leadership on headcount planning and org design

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience building a people function from scratch at a high-growth startup

  • Strong sourcing chops, going beyond LinkedIn and close competitive candidates creatively

  • Hands-on with modern recruiting tools and ATS platforms (we currently use Ashby)

  • Equally comfortable in the weeds of people ops and thinking strategically about org health

  • High ownership and scrappy – you build the plane while flying it!

Bonus

  • Experience hiring enterprise or technical talent

  • Background in tech or SaaS sales

  • Familiarity with insurance or financial services

Why join

  • Get in early at a company that's already won with $108M raise

  • Direct line to leadership and real influence over how we grow

  • You're not inheriting someone else's playbook — you're writing it

Compensation

  • Base: $160,000-$230,000

  • Equity: included

Interview Process

  1. Screening Call

  2. Work Trial

  3. Decision

jobs.title: Quantitative Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Chicago, IL and London, UK

Compensation: $200,000-$350,000 or £150,000-£250,000 | Equity Options

About Corgi

Corgi is a full-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products from the ground up. We're not just a broker: we design, underwrite, price, and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so. YC S24.

What You'll Do

  • This is a unique role for someone who likes to find the answer in the numbers and build quantitative driven solutions to help us solve some of the hardest problems in insurance and portfolio management.

  • Build and maintain quantitative models to support pricing, underwriting, forecasting, and business decision-making.

  • Support the Head of Underwriting in:

    • The management of the Corgi insurance portfolio and development of underwriting strategy.

    • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify insurance trends, risks, and opportunities

    • Partner with engineering and product teams to implement the results of your findings.

  • Support the Head of Quantitative Strategy in the management of the Corgi investment portfolio and the development of our investment strategy.

    • Design experiments and evaluate outcomes using statistical methods.

    • Build and stress-test trade ideas from concept to execution that will directly contribute to the management of the investment portfolio.

  • Support strategic initiatives across insurance, operations, finance, and growth.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong quantitative background in mathematics, statistics, economics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Familiarity with statistical modeling, forecasting, optimization, or machine learning techniques.

  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively.

  • Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn new domains quickly.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in insurance, financial services, capital markets, or other data-intensive industries.

  • Exposure to predictive modeling, risk modeling, or actuarial concepts.

  • Experience building production analytical tools or models.

  • Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based analytics platforms.

  • Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline.

Why Corgi

  • Work directly on some of the hardest problems in insurance

  • Build models that influence real-world decisions and outcomes

  • Join a small, highly ambitious team with significant ownership and autonomy

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

  • Opportunity to help build a category-defining company from the ground up

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Senior Accountant in Las Vegas, NV.

Corgi is vertically integrating the entire insurance industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so.

Building something great requires working hard. We are in the office 6-7 days a week. We are meritocratic with very high standards. If you don't meet them, you'll get cut. But if you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow.

We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.

This is not a back-office role. You’ll be at the center of the business: owning the close, working across entities, and helping leadership understand exactly how the company is performing.

What You'll Do

  • Own the month-end close across multiple entities: journal entries, reconciliations, and general ledger.

  • Manage accruals and prepaids with precision, get expenses into the right periods.

  • Build and maintain intercompany schedules and support consolidation and elimination entries.

  • Produce clear, accurate financial reporting across entities and at the consolidated level.

  • Drive audit including clean workpapers, strong documentation, and no surprises.

  • Partner with ops, finance, and legal to support budgets, forecasts, and decision-making.

  • Identify and implement process improvements as we scale.

  • Support acquisitions and new entity integrations as we grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience (public accounting strongly preferred, Big 4 or regional).

  • Strong GAAP foundation (you understand the why, not just the how).

  • Experience with multi-entity environments, consolidations, and intercompany accounting is a big plus.

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, high-complexity environment.

  • Detail-oriented but able to zoom out: you can talk to leadership, not just post entries.

  • Bias for ownership and speed, you figure things out and get it done.

  • CPA or active CPA candidate preferred.

Why Join Corgi

Ownership: This role sits at the core of the business and what you do directly impacts decisions.

Ground Floor: Help build the financial backbone of a generational company

Speed & Impact: Close fast, build systems, and see your work matter immediately

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $80,000 – $95,000 (depending on experience and CPA status).

Let’s build something massive.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Chicago, IL & London, GB | $125,000 - $200,000 | £60,000 - £90,000 | Equity Options

Corgi is vertically integrating the entire insurance industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so.

Building something great requires working hard. We are in the office 6-7 days a week. We are meritocratic with very high standards. If you don't meet them, you'll get cut. But if you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow.

We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.

As a Strategic Projects Associate, you’ll work across high-priority initiatives that help scale Corgi — from research and regulatory work to new initiatives, special projects, and cross-functional problem solving. You’ll partner closely with leadership and gain visibility into how a fast-growing company is built.

 

What You'll Do

  • Support high-priority strategic initiatives across the business.

  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, regulations, and emerging opportunities.

  • Draft and organize written materials including analyses, filings, presentations, and internal documentation.

  • Help evaluate and execute new projects, partnerships, and operational initiatives.

  • Translate ambiguous problems into structured recommendations and action plans.

  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to move projects forward.

  • Build systems, documentation, and processes that support Corgi’s growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • Curious, intellectually driven, and eager to learn quickly.

  • Strong researcher and clear communicator with excellent written skills.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Comfortable working through ambiguity and figuring things out independently.

  • High ownership mindset and willingness to tackle unfamiliar problems.

  • Excited by growth, steep learning curves, and meaningful responsibility.

 

Why This Role

  • High visibility and direct exposure to company-building.

  • Broad scope across strategy, research, and special projects.

  • Opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly scaling company.

  • Meaningful ownership early in your career.

  • Work that is challenging, varied, and high impact.

jobs.title: Financial Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
£80,000 - £150,000 | Equity Options

Locations: London

About Corgi

Corgi is a full-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products for startups. We underwrite and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Cutting out intermediaries lets us tailor coverage to how companies actually operate and price risk more efficiently.

We form and operate insurance companies from the ground up, using AI and software to automate the workflows traditionally handled by large teams of brokers, underwriters, TPAs, accountants, and operations staff. Our goal is not to incrementally improve insurance, it is to rebuild the industry infrastructure itself.

We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.

The Role

We’re hiring a Financial Operations Associate to help build and scale the financial backbone of Corgi.

This role sits at the intersection of finance, accounting, and operations. You’ll help ensure money moves correctly, systems work cleanly, and financial processes scale with the business. This is not a purely administrative role— we want someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity, improving systems, and taking ownership of important operational workflows.

You’ll work closely with finance, accounting, and leadership teams to help keep the company running smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day financial operations across the business.

  • Manage and track payments, vendor relationships, and financial workflows.

  • Assist with reconciliations, reporting, and month-end processes.

  • Help oversee payroll funding and internal financial transfers.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and operational documentation.

  • Identify inefficiencies and help improve financial systems and processes.

  • Coordinate across teams to ensure financial information is accurate and timely.

  • Support audits, compliance, and operational finance projects as needed.

  • Take ownership of special projects and operational problem-solving.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–4 years of experience in finance, accounting, operations, bookkeeping, AP/AR, or related roles.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial systems.

  • Reliable and able to manage multiple moving pieces at once.

  • Strong follow-through and ownership mentality.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving environment with evolving processes.

  • Clear communicator who works well cross-functionally.

  • Experience with payroll, accounting software, or financial systems is a plus but not required.

You Might Be a Fit If You...

  • Like making messy processes run smoothly.

  • Notice details that other people miss.

  • Enjoy building systems and improving workflows.

  • Want meaningful ownership and broad exposure.

  • Take pride in keeping important operations running well.

Why Join Corgi

  • High ownership and meaningful responsibility.

  • Opportunity to help build finance and operations from the ground up.

  • Smart, curious, and collaborative team.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • A chance to help reinvent insurance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Flexible Compensation and Equity Options

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Las Vegas, NV
Compensation: $90,000 – $120,000 + Benefits

The Role

Corgi is a full-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products from the ground up. We're not just a broker: we design, underwrite, price, and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so. YC S24.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building processes, driving accuracy, and creating operational excellence. You'll oversee the full accounts payable lifecycle, including vendor payments, expense management, and insurance claims disbursements. You'll partner closely with accounting, finance, and claims teams to ensure payments are processed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across multiple entities.

  • Review, approve, and process vendor invoices and payment requests.

  • Manage payment runs and ensure vendors are paid accurately and on time.

  • Process and oversee insurance claims-related payments, ensuring timely and accurate disbursement to claimants, vendors, attorneys, and service providers.

  • Track claims payment activity and work closely with claims teams to resolve discrepancies and payment issues.

  • Reconcile accounts payable and claims payment activity to the general ledger.

  • Monitor outstanding liabilities and payment obligations across the organization.

  • Oversee corporate credit card, employee reimbursement, and expense management programs.

  • Maintain vendor records, tax documentation, and payment controls.

  • Support month-end and year-end close processes, including accruals and account reconciliations.

  • Assist with audits, regulatory examinations, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Develop, document, and improve AP policies, controls, and workflows.

  • Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.

  • Build and manage a high-performing accounts payable function as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in accounts payable, accounting, or finance.

  • Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, internal controls, and financial operations.

  • Experience managing high-volume payment processing and reconciliations.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with accounting systems, ERP platforms, and Excel.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to improve processes rather than simply maintain them.

Nice to Have

  • Insurance industry experience.

  • Experience processing insurance claims payments or supporting claims operations.

  • Experience in a multi-entity environment.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members.

  • Familiarity with AP automation, procurement, and expense management systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Why Corgi

  • Help build the financial operations behind a category-defining insurance company.

  • Own critical processes with significant responsibility and visibility.

  • Work alongside an ambitious, high-caliber team.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling business.

jobs.title: Sports & Entertainment Underwriting Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

Location: London, UK or Remote (US)

Compensation: $150,000–$250,000 (US) or £100,000–£200,000 (UK), total compensation including equity

About Corgi

Corgi is a full-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products from the ground up. We're not just a broker: we design, underwrite, price, and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others at a $2.6B valuation to do so. YC S24.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Sports Underwriting to own our sports book – pricing, appetite, wordings, and referrals. We're the carrier, not a broker and not an MGA fronting for someone else, so what you decide is what actually happens. The book is still small today – mostly P&C, like general liability, participant liability, D&O, and abuse & misconduct, plus some smaller contingency and A&H lines. We write it for national governing bodies (NGBs), professional teams, and events, and we want to grow it substantially from here.

The ideal candidate can do all of this, not just price it or just write the wording, or has a strong base and is willing to learn quickly. You'll have a real say in pricing, policy design and wording, appetite, and risk selection. Our underwriting runs on an AI-native stack, which empowers our underwriters to have 10x more impact.

What You'll Do

  • Own risk selection, pricing, and appetite across NGBs, professional teams, and events.

  • Shape policy design and wording, not just the rate.

  • Codify your judgment into rating models, appetite rules, and referral logic.

  • Review referrals and complex risks, and feed every decision back into the system.

  • Build and lead the sports underwriting team from the ground up as the book scales.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years underwriting sports, leisure, or entertainment risks at a carrier, MGA, or Lloyd's syndicate – this is a specialist seat, not a generalist one.

  • Strong P&C fundamentals across liability lines.

  • Fluency in sports exposure: sanctioned events, club and NGB structures.

  • Well-rounded: credible on pricing, wordings, appetite, and risk selection.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Nice to Have

  • Contingency or A&H exposure alongside your P&C book.

  • Experience building rating plans, appetite frameworks, or underwriting guidelines from scratch.

  • Experience hiring and leading underwriters.

Why Corgi

  • Take an early-stage book to scale and own the team behind it.

  • Underwrite on our own paper – no fronting carrier's appetite to work around.

  • Build the models and rules that underwrite every sports risk we write.

  • Work with us directly, not through layers of management.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: Employment Lawyer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the job

Alongside Corgi, we operate an MSO that supports adjacent legal practices. Bulldog Trial Lawyers is one of those practices as a plaintiff-side employment firm that is looking for its first litigators and partners. The firm is backed with capital and an operations team of the MSO.

 

We need our first litigators.

The candidate will be crucial to growing the practice. We expect you to take cases now and mentor associates as we add them. We do not expect you to handle marketing, tech, or payroll. We handle everything non-legal.

The first attorneys we hire get favorable draw, equity and bonus packages. Experience gained in building out the firm in the first few months will be priceless and put you head and shoulders above the 10th or 100th litigator we hire. Comp is structured around a guaranteed draw plus contingency participation — uncapped.

Geography is flexible. We open the office where you are. AZ, NV, NY, NJ, MA, WA, TN, GA, FL, CO — all on the table.

 

Who we want.

  • Plaintiff employment litigator with experience in discrimination, retaliation, wrongful termination, harassment, wage & hour.

  • The ability to take a case from intake through trial or settlement without hand-holding.

  • 3+ years preferred; will consider 2 years for the right candidate.

  • Active bar in any US jurisdiction.

  • If you've built your own firm before - you will have unmatched support and resources this time.

 

What we offer.

  • Guaranteed draw — $200k with contingency-fee participation targeting $250,000+ all-in compensation.

  • Equity.

  • Full back-office: intake, marketing, case management platform, paralegal support, IT, IOLTA, billing. Support in everything you could need to be successful and grow the practice with us.

 

If you work in employment law and want to be part of the most ambitious firm in the nation, apply.

 

DM Anton Burton on LinkedIn or email anton@corgi.insure. Confidential inquiries welcome.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: London, UK (In-Office)

Experience: 5+ years required

Compensation: £140,000 - £200,000 + equity

Visa Sponsorship: Not available

About Corgi

Corgi is vertically integrating the entire insurance industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly: no brokers, no third-party administrators. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $268M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so.

Building something great requires working hard. We are in the office 6-7 days a week. We are meritocratic with very high standards. If you don't meet them, you'll get cut. But if you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow.

We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the design and development of the systems that power our insurance companies and internal operations.

You will own large technical initiatives across underwriting, claims, finance, compliance, and internal tooling. You'll work directly with leadership, product, and operations teams to build software that eliminates manual work and enables the company to scale. This role is for someone who wants significant ownership, enjoys solving complex problems, and can independently drive projects from concept to production.

This role is based in our London office.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain critical internal and customer-facing software systems.

  • Lead the development of backend services, APIs, and scalable infrastructure.

  • Own major projects from architecture through deployment and ongoing maintenance.

  • Work across the stack to rapidly ship products and features.

  • Partner closely with operations, finance, underwriting, and leadership teams to automate complex workflows.

  • Improve system reliability, performance, security, and scalability.

  • Make architectural decisions and establish engineering best practices.

  • Mentor engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Help shape the future direction of our engineering organization.

Who You Are

  • Exceptional software engineering fundamentals.

  • Comfortable operating with limited structure and high levels of responsibility.

  • Strong product and business intuition.

  • High ownership and relentless execution.

  • Able to balance speed with sound technical judgment.

  • Excited by difficult technical and operational challenges.

  • Interested in building software that directly impacts how businesses operate.

Preferred Experience

  • 5+ years of software engineering work experience.

  • Experienced in Typescript, Python, React, FastAPI, Django, Flask, and AWS.

  • Strong experience designing distributed systems and scalable applications.

  • Experience owning production systems and making architectural decisions.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, and modern development practices.

  • Built significant personal, startup, or professional projects.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, workflow automation, or other complex operational businesses is helpful but not required.

Why Join

  • Build foundational systems for a new kind of insurance company.

  • Own business-critical systems and technical decisions.

  • Work directly with senior leadership and core operators.

  • High ownership and visibility from day one.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

  • Opportunity to help define how insurance infrastructure is built in the AI era.

  • Office corgi!

jobs.title: Founding BDR - Orem
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Orem, Utah

Compensation: $50,000 - $120,000, discussed further during interview process

About Corgi

Corgi has built the first full-stack, AI-native insurance carrier designed from the ground up for startups and high-growth companies. Unlike traditional insurance brokers, Corgi underwrites, prices, and issues policies directly, cutting out the middlemen and the friction that usually comes with getting a business covered. Insurance was one of the last major corners of financial services that hadn't been meaningfully modernized and we've rebuilt it end to end.

Backed by Y Combinator and other top-tier investors, Corgi has grown into one of the fastest-scaling companies in the insurance industry, now valued at $4 billion. We currently operate out of San Francisco, Salt Lake City, Chicago, Atlanta, New York, and London and we're now opening a brand-new office in Orem, Utah.

The Opportunity

This is a ground-floor opportunity. You'll be a Founding BDR of Corgi's Orem office. You’ll help shape its culture, its playbook, and its early wins. If you want the upside of startup ownership with the backing of a company that's already proven its model at scale, this is it.

What You'll Do

• Make high-volume outbound calls and outreach to startup founders, operators, and finance leaders.

• Qualify outbound leads and move them through the top of the sales funnel.

• Own your CRM hygiene — accurate notes, next steps, and follow-through on every deal in your pipeline.

• Partner closely with Account Executives and underwriting to hand off qualified opportunities.

• Hit and exceed weekly and monthly activity and pipeline targets.

What We're Looking For

• Competitive drive and a track record of hitting quota.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; you're comfortable picking up the phone and getting told "no".

• Coachability and a genuine desire to improve quickly.

• Comfort within a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. This is NOT a basic 9-to-5.

• No prior insurance experience required. We'll train you on the product and the industry.

Why Corgi

• Join a YC-backed company at real scale.

• Uncapped growth: Corgi is meritocratic so if you perform, there is no ceiling on how fast you can move up.

• Be part of the founding team of a brand-new office, with the visibility that comes with it.

• Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission (compensation details provided during the interview process).

• Direct exposure to leadership and real ownership over how this office is built.

Culture Note

Corgi moves fast and expects a lot from its team. We work hard, hold each other to a high standard, and reward performance. This role is best suited for people who want to be challenged and are motivated by rapid growth.
